data_fields.name: fingerprint_scope
data_fields.donor_constant: remote source only; skipped when current team has gone

best_idea: Fold the game's state into a per-turn fingerprint and into the random stream at the same fixed points on both sides, so drift shows up at the next turn end instead of as a silent wrong result.
decision_why: The per-turn fingerprint, history-fed stream and stamped commands fit row 19 and the server's record; the donor's argument-fold, order-dependent injection and XOR-fold defects are fixed in the clean-room sketch, and the team-gone skip is kept only as a logged result.
acceptance: A stored fight record replays to the same per-turn fingerprints; moving one gear by one unit changes the next turn fingerprint; reordering the gear list does not; changing only a command argument changes it; a skipped check appears in the ledger with its reason.
